subject: PrivDeploy commercial construct, platform-fee smoothing & support slab
messages:
From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Anita Shah <anita.shah@heliumhealth.com>, Kenji Sato <kenji.sato@heliumhealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-02-18T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: PrivDeploy commercial construct, platform-fee smoothing & support slab

Hi Anita / Kenji —

Thanks for the time yesterday. Attached is a first-pass term sheet for the Private (VPC/on-prem) deployment we discussed (Redwood_PrivDeploy_TermSheet_v1.pdf). I wanted to surface a commercial approach we think will balance Helium’s capital planning constraints and our platform economics:

Key proposal (high-level)
- Commit length: 18 months (start date upon first node provisioning)
- Platform fee: annualized platform fee that we can smooth over the commit instead of an up-front commercial amortization
- Discount phasing: 15% off list in year 1 with the ability to step down to 10% in year 2 depending on true-up usage
- Support: Standard SRE retainer included (business hours SLA). Optional 24/7 on-call add-on (separate line item)
- Migration credit: One-time migration credit (applied against first invoice) tied to a minimal pilot and checklist completion

What we need from you to finalize:
1) Confirmation that an 18-month staggered amortization is acceptable to procurement/finance
2) Any hard budget constraints or prepay requirements (CapEx vs OpEx preference)
3) Clarify whether Helium requires an on-prem image escrow or only VPC-managed nodes (affects support scope)

Next steps: if those items look reasonable, we’ll provide a fee-breakdown CSV that maps platform fee amortization to invoices and SOW milestones. I’ve copied Marissa (commercial) to propose a counter if any of these items don’t align.

Appreciate quick feedback — we’re trying to keep a tight timeline for your FY planning.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Director, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0112

Attachment: Redwood_PrivDeploy_TermSheet_v1.pdf (pdf)

From: Anita Shah <anita.shah@heliumhealth.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kenji Sato <kenji.sato@heliumhealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@heliumhealth.com>
Date: 2026-02-18T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: PrivDeploy commercial construct, platform-fee smoothing & support slab

Laura —

Thanks for sending this over and for the call. A few quick clarifications from procurement/infra:

- Procurement asks for the exact invoice cadence if platform fee is annualized (monthly invoices vs quarterly). We need a mapping we can show finance.
- Can you confirm whether the ‘migration credit’ requires a separate SOW or if it can be a line-item credit contingent on pilot acceptance?
- Security wants a short addendum covering data-at-rest encryption, customer KMS, and audit logs — can you attach your standard addendum or point to the doc?

Kenji (cc) — I’m looping you for infra impact: do you need the dedicated image or is managed VPC ok? Also, any constraints on on-call escalation?

If you can send the fee breakdown and a short security addendum I can route to finance and security for preliminary sign-off.

Best,
Anita Shah
Head of Procurement, Helium Health
anita.shah@heliumhealth.com

From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Anita Shah <anita.shah@heliumhealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@heliumhealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, irene_choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-02-18T13:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: PrivDeploy commercial construct, platform-fee smoothing & support slab

Anita — thank you. Quick answers inline and next actions below.

- Invoice cadence: Default we can do monthly invoices with the platform fee amortized across the monthly cycle. We can also provide quarterly invoices if finance prefers a lower invoice count — let us know preference.
- Migration credit: We prefer to attach the migration credit as a line-item credit on the first invoice contingent on pilot acceptance (simpler than a separate SOW). If your procurement requires a separate SOW we can accommodate — let us know.
- Security addendum: attaching a short security addendum and the fee breakdown CSV now (privdeploy-fee-breakdown.csv, Helium_Security_Addendum.pdf). The addendum covers KMS integration, audit log retention options, and our standard SOC2 evidentiary references.

Irene — copied to give finance-level amortization detail and confirm whether we can offer the quarterly invoicing option as part of this deal.
Rishi — looping for a quick read on the suggested amortization language that Anita’s team may want to see in the contract.

Deliverables attached: privdeploy-fee-breakdown.csv (spreadsheet), Helium_Security_Addendum.pdf (pdf)

Next steps:
- Marissa to propose a commercial counter if any of the cadence/discount items need adjustment
- Helium to confirm invoice cadence and whether separate SOW required for migration credit

Laura

Attachment: privdeploy-fee-breakdown.csv (csv); Helium_Security_Addendum.pdf (pdf)

--- Forwarded message from laura_bennett ---

[original term sheet attached]

Rishi (legal) notes for procurement:
1) Amortization language: propose explicit formula that ties platform fee amortization to the committed node count and a quarterly true-up mechanism. This prevents divergence if Helium scales faster/slower.
2) Exit protection: recommend a 90-day cap on exit costs and a defined runbook for deprovisioning (to reduce operational disputes).
3) Data protections: accept KMS language but require mutual indemnity carve-outs for third-party managed components.

Irene / Marissa: I’ll add the above as tracked changes and circulate a short redline within 48 hours.

Rishi Malhotra

Laura / Marissa —

Two infra items from our end:
1) Support tiers: we need clarity on what’s in the Standard SRE retainer vs the 24/7 add-on. Specifically: incident response windows, paging hierarchy, and credit calculations for SLA misses.
2) Dedicated image: we prefer a customer-hosted on-prem image for the pilot; can Redwood support an image handoff + ops runbook? There is also a potential security requirement for image escrow.

Finally, our migration team would like to understand how you calculate the migration credit — is it based on hours or a flat-dollar allowance? If hours, can you provide an SRE hourly rate?

From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-02-20T17:40:00-08:00
Subject: RE: PrivDeploy commercial construct, platform-fee smoothing & support slab

Anita / Kenji —

Appreciate the questions — below is a commercial counter that keeps Helium’s cash planning in mind while protecting Redwood’s cost model. Happy to set a quick call to walk through.

Commercial counter (summary) - Term: 18 months (aligned with Laura’s note)
- Invoice cadence: monthly (we will provide a monthly amortization schedule). Quarterly invoicing possible on request.
- Platform fee: spread evenly across the 18-month term; we’ll include a quarterly true-up tied to actual node count/usage.
- Discount: 15% off list on months 1–12; 10% off list on months 13–18 (true-up applies)
- Migration credit: one-time $30,000 credit applied against invoice #1. If Helium prefers hour-based, SRE rate is $275/hr and we’ll cap at 120 hours unless otherwise agreed.
- Support: Standard retainer includes business-hours (M–F, 08:00–18:00) SRE with 8-hour response for Sev2 and 24-hour for Sev3. 24/7 on-call add-on available for an additional fixed monthly retainer (proposed $14,500/mo). Credits: 10% of monthly invoice for a Sev1 SLA miss (response > 60m) and 5% for repeat Sev2 misses per quarter.
- Dedicated image: we can provide a hardened customer image and an ops handoff runbook. Escrow is available as a paid add-on.
- Exit cap: aligning with Rishi’s suggestion we accept a 90-day exit cap (pro-rated) — details will be in the redline.

Next steps:
1) Laura to circulate term sheet with redline (legal) that includes amortization formula and exit runbook language.
2) Helium to confirm invoice cadence preference (monthly vs quarterly) and accept migration credit structure (flat credit vs hours).
3) If acceptable, we’ll send a DocuSign bundle with term sheet + security addendum + SOW stub.

I can be on a call tomorrow morning PST if you want to run through the counter.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Commercial Lead, Enterprise | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0199
